# 🇪🇪 Radio from Estonia

**50 stations**, every one opened and confirmed to return audio on **2026-08-23**.

## How to listen

| | |
|---|---|
| **In your browser** | **[globalradio.app/estonia](https://globalradio.app/estonia/)** — press play, no install, keeps playing while you browse |
| **In a player** | `mpv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eyalev/verified-radio-streams/main/m3u/EE.m3u` — or open that URL in VLC |
| **In your own code** | [`stations/EE.json`](../../../stations/EE.json) |

## Start here

The most-voted stations in Estonia, each with a page of its own:

- **[Rock FM](stations/rock-fm.md)** — rock · 320 kbps MP3 · 5,091 votes
- **[FinEst Radio](stations/finest-radio.md)** — genre not labelled · 192 kbps MP3 · 1,423 votes
- **[Raadio Kuku](stations/raadio-kuku.md)** — genre not labelled · 320 kbps MP3 · 1,389 votes
- **[Star Fm](stations/star-fm.md)** — genre not labelled · AAC · 1,303 votes

## Browse by genre

**pop** (6) — Võmba FM · Raadio Duo · R2 Eesti · Retro Love · Star FM · Radio Olematu

**dance** (5) — Sky Plus DnB · NRJ Tallinn · NRJ · Duo Party · PCR.fm (Parnu Club Radio)

**jazz** (3) — Relax cafe · KlaRa Nostalgia · KlaRa Jazz

**oldies** (3) — Retro Love · Radio Nostalgia · Duo Gold (Estonia)

> 26 of 50 stations here carry **no genre tag at all**, so
> these lists are a way in, not a classification of the country's radio. A
> station missing from every genre above is unlabelled, not uncategorisable.

## All 50 stations

Ordered by votes on [Radio Browser](https://www.radio-browser.info), which is a
crowd signal and not a ranking this project stands behind.

**▶︎ listen** opens the audio stream itself — it plays in most browsers and in
any media player. To press play on a page instead, with the station list beside
it, open **[globalradio.app/estonia](https://globalradio.app/estonia/)**. A station
name is a link only when it has a page in this repo.

## What the columns do and do not say

- **Genre** is crowd-submitted and often absent — 26 of 50 stations
  here have none. Absent means nobody labelled it, not that it plays nothing.
- **Quality** is what the server reported when the stream was opened. `—`
  means it reported nothing.
- **Listen** is the raw audio URL. It belongs to the broadcaster, not to this
  project, and may be geo-blocked where you are.
- **site** is the station's own website, as its operators gave it to Radio
  Browser. Some are stale; none of them were checked by this project — only the
  streams were.

Every station also carries the date its stream last answered — see
[`stations/EE.json`](../../../stations/EE.json) or any station page above.
